title: What a requesting app receives, and what a retraction looks like
description: The class and the age travel with the value. The evidence never does. A requesting app needs enough to decide how much weight to give a value, and not enough to reconstruct the holder's private signals.

fieldValue.$comment: Note what is absent: derived_from, confidence and source_app are holder-only. additionalProperties is false so an implementation cannot quietly widen this.

retraction.description: Rule 4. Emitted to every app in the field's receipt log when the holder edits or deletes. A retraction cannot un-read data and cannot un-train a model. It stops future reads, timestamps the withdrawal, and makes any use after that timestamp a documented breach rather than a dispute about memory.

state.description: Visible to the holder per app. Apps that ignore retractions lose write access; the enforcement lever is market access, not cryptography.
